title: Persuasion Dynamics in LLMs: Investigating Robustness and Adaptability in Knowledge and Safety with DuET-PD
reasoning: The paper uses the SALAD-Bench safety benchmark, which includes categories such as 'Human Autonomy & Integrity', 'Socioeconomic Harms', and 'Malicious Use'. These categories directly involve evaluating the model's stance on ethical principles and moral judgments under persuasive pressure.
